purpose: Matched native evolving Franka scenes, independent of fine FEM reference qualification.
output_contract: Stress buffers computed and kept on GPU; no per-step host full-field transfer.
required_runtime_acceptance: Unchanged production checks and invalid-environment counters; any nonzero count/failure rejects a primary throughput row.
research_overhead: Warmup quality and post-run metadata excluded; trajectory_metrics/trace disabled.
gpu_pairing: All five scopes of each batch run sequentially within one GPU allocation; different batches may use different GPUs.
timing_units: env scene-steps/s; no policy inference/training; recovery-only counts are separate.
physical_error: Pending for this native-collider load configuration. Never join with compliant-pad 2mm error.
limitations: Pilot does not establish large-batch capacity.
Full-path/motion conformance and changing-contact module replay need separate controls.
Frozen-contact recovery scope is not a history replay and is excluded from this pilot.
Warm repetitions are not independent-process repeats.
